note: Free, deterministic signals on a step's diff. A claimed step whose every added line has no effect triggers one which-ask reading on its own diff; a trigger only adds a reading, never decides. Facts of the diff only.

no_effect.cosmetic: every added line is blank, a comment, or a reordering of removed lines
no_effect.docs_only: every changed path is documentation (*.md, *.rst, *.txt, docs/)
no_effect.python_dead_code: every added code line is an import whose name the added lines never use, or an assignment to a name they never read (unreachable code needs the whole file and is not judged)
